name: branding-logo-clear-space-diagram-with-block-seven-mark
title: Logo clear-space grid with X, X/2 and X/4 measurements around a block mark and blocky wordmark
whatItIs: A light grey page with dashed grid lines, a black quarter-circle-and-block symbol with a dot and a custom stencil-like wordmark, surrounded by shaded margins labelled X/2, X/4 and a dimension arrow marked X.
whatItMeans: Precise and systematic; showing the rules behind the logo signals maturity.
techniques: Show clear space as shaded margins with fractional labels.
Use a dashed grid over pale grey.
Design a custom wordmark from stencil-cut rounded blocks.
Keep the diagram in black and grey.

vocabulary.definition: Minimum empty area around a logo.
A measure based on part of the logo.
Lettering with breaks like a stencil.
